# Random number generator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/random-numbers/

Generate random integers with browser cryptographic randomness. Choose a minimum, maximum, count and whether results may repeat.

## How to use it

1. Choose or enter the content for this tool.
2. Start the action with the settings you want.
3. Review the result before copying, sharing or continuing.

## Example

Pick ten unique numbers between 1 and 100 for a simple classroom exercise.

## Limits and checks

This is a local utility, not an audited lottery platform. A unique selection cannot exceed the number of values in its range.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
